title: Drain the built lane PR backlog to a final state
why: Owner 10:45 CST Nov 13 approved plan backlog-drain (ruling backlog-drain-plan, Cockpit item 691 a). 356 built lane PRs sat unbatched at 09:55 CST, and some repeat each other.
note: Parts 3 to 6 of the plan (R66 in plans/restart-plan.md): close repeats within each step group by git cherry or patch-id, with a pointer to the kept PR; one fresh Sonnet reviewer per remaining group and per older single PR picks keep, rebuild or close; runner 10 batches keep rows that read done, newest first, and keep rows without a done record get one fresh Sonnet round 1; finish when unsorted rows in roadmap/backlog/lost-prs.json reach 0. Needs the ledger from step lost-work-sweep (part 2). Until it lands, the shared number is runner 10's read of open lane PRs in no batch from plain merge --reviewed (402 at 10:42 CST, 108 done). One lane, under the coordinator; runner 10 only batches. Lane started by the coordinator 10:48 CST Nov 13. Coordinator took item 693 a at 10:51 CST Nov 13, as a pick that can be undone: drain first with big batches. New lanes pause except drain lanes, express merge-flow fixes and CI fixes until the shared number has no unsorted row. Runner 10 builds drain batches of every done keep row that passes lane lint. The item stays visible for the owner to override. Owner picked item 693 a himself at 10:50 CST Nov 13 (ruling drain-first-hold, R67); it replaces the coordinator's 10:51 pick. The hold ends when the ledger shows no unsorted row and handin-cannot-drop, lost-work-sweep and lane-step-dup-check are on main.
